title: Meeting room projector shows no signal
symptom: The meeting room projector is on but shows No signal when the laptop is connected
user_description: My client meeting starts in ten minutes and the projector just says No signal. The laptop is plugged in with the cable on the table. Please help!

options.why: The projector turns on and shows a message, so it works. The problem is the cable, the input or the laptop setting.

options.text: Restart the laptop again and again until it works
options.why: Restarting does not fix a loose cable or the wrong input, and wastes the time before the meeting.

options.text: Tell her to present on the laptop screen instead
options.why: That does not fix the problem, and the next meeting will have it too.

options.text: Check the HDMI cable is firmly in at both ends, set the projector to the input the cable is plugged into, and check the laptop's Windows key + P setting (Duplicate or Extend)
options.why: No signal means the projector is not getting a picture on the input it is set to. These three checks fix most meeting room display problems.

hints: The projector works: what does No signal mean?
Which input is the cable plugged into?
What does Windows key + P do?
real_world_tip: Projectors and TVs have several inputs, like HDMI 1 and HDMI 2. Check the label next to the port the cable is in, then pick that input.
